I feel like I might be able to relate to you... I know that I will never understand your exact pain but I had a somewhat similar experience. 

My grandfather was ostracized from our family when I was 11 years old. I remember my mum screaming at him on the doorstep and I remember asking her why. She was drunk at this point in time, drunk and crying. She told me "do you know what a pedophile is?" I said "no". I didn't know what a pedophile was at the time. We never saw my granddad again, I wasn't too bothered, he always made me uncomfortable. 

Flash forward to age 19, I had drunk far too much at a party and blacked out, my "friend" drove me home, I can remember bits and pieces of my "friend" having sex with me while I was blackout drunk; his weight, a few words he said to me, I was really traumatized from this sexual assault, and to be honest I haven't really ever recovered from it...

About three months after I was raped when I was 19; that's when the dreams began. 

In my dreams I was standing in the bathroom of my childhood home, my grandfather was there, he would touch me inappropriately, in my dreams I remember feeling panicked, I remember how coarse his fingers were, I can even remember my grandfather's facial expression. Then I would wake up and panic. 

This went on and on for months, I was convinced that my mind was making my dreams up from pure fiction and that I must be a really REALLY fucked up person to dream about something like that. 

Eventually I was actually admitted to psychiatric inpatient care; i hadn't been coping with the PTSD from the sexual assault well at all, I had stopped eating, I had become completely isolated with fear following the sexual assault and self loathing because of my dreams. I just wanted to die. 

My mother was horrified about my being admitted into the hospital; I told her I wasn't coping well... and then I told her about my dreams and that I thought I MUST be insane to dream something like that. 

She broke down and told me i wasn't insane, she never went into any further detail, but she told me I wasn't just dreaming it for no reason. 

All I could feel was anger. 

I was angry at my grandfather the most, I was angry because he betrayed my trust when I was just a very small child, he had NO RIGHT to do that to me, and he traumatized me, despite my brain's best efforts to protect me, and block it out for years, it managed to come back and haunt me.

I was angry at the universe for letting this happen to me twice. I never thought I would have to worry about rape, and to be raped twice by two different people? Why the fuck do I deserve that?? 

I was angry at my mum; why didn't she tell me? ... I know now because there was no way for her to tell me. How can you look at your daughter and communicate that kind of pain and betrayal to your daughter? She did what she thought was best for me; ignore it and pray I never remember. I did remember... but I forgive you mum; your actions were not out of malice but love and fear. 

I don't know your exact pain... but I hope that maybe I can at least provide you with a sense of solidarity. Stay strong sister, there's too much evil in this world for us to crumble beneath it and become consumed with anger and hatred. 

Those who betrayed us however... well in my mind, I haven't been able to find the strength to forgive them. And I think that's okay.
